links.outcome: EREFS scoring accuracy of multimodal LLMs versus GI specialists and fellows against anchor-rater
links.effect: Overall accuracy: fellows 72.4%, specialists 65.3%, LLMs 58.9% (p<0.001). LLMs beat specialists on edema (83.3% vs 49.3%) but were worse on rings (30% vs 58%). After few-shot prompting LLMs matched specialists (62.7% vs 65.3%, p=0.3).
links.quote: Overall assessment accuracy was significantly higher among GI fellows (72.4 %) compared to specialists (65.3 %, p = 0.004) and LLMs (58.9 %, p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Few-shot prompting to improve multimodal LLM accuracy on endoscopic image scoring

screen.reason: Evaluates multimodal LLMs compared to clinicians on endoscopic image scoring and tests the effect of few-shot prompting versus zero/single-shot on diagnostic performance.
